## What the two statuses mean

**shipped** — the artifact in this repository is the thing that installs. Run the command and it works.

**external** — the artifact is complete and correct, and publication is a platform action this repository cannot perform: a marketplace review, an app submission. The manifest is real; the listing is not ours to claim, so it is not claimed.

There is no third status. A target with no artifact does not appear here.

## One declaration

Every file under `distributions/` is generated by `scripts/build_distributions.py` from `maxey0_ss/distribution/registry.py`, and packaging refuses to run if they have drifted. A plugin id that disagrees with the package name that disagrees with the MCP server name does not fail a test — it fails for a user, once, at install, with no diagnostic.
